term: same performed act at every accessible world
definition: For a selected standpoint w and one rigid token a, performs v a holds at every v accessible from w. This is not necessity of some possibly different act, a metaphysical identity criterion for acts, or source necessity.
note: Explicit diagnostic for issue #462; no source attribution. Source-grounded act individuation and metaphysical adoption remain open. See docs/notes/selected-effect-bridge-462.md.
